family_reports.body: They have robbed me and my children of precious time we will never get back

They lost my son, he has been missing since September 23, 2025. They have consistently tried to cover up the unconstitutional seizure of my children. They scrubbed reports and gave my 8 year old daughter to our abuser and placed my 15 year old daughter with a pedophile.

The system tried to destroy and break our family simply for money because three of our children have disabilities they could cash in on. That same system tried to silence us l, paint us as liars, when the proof didn’t match the story they were telling. WE WILL NEVER STOP TELLING OUR STORY!!! If we help and save just one other family it was not for nothing. We are together. Our family fights together. They chose the wrong ones. All of my children are home because our voices, our proof, MATTERED.

public_comments.comment_text: Was court appointed but would not take my calls. Told me I messaged him to much. Would not respect my wishes. Would not push the issue of no 7-10 day hearing. Would not push visitation or file a motion for it even tho I asked. Would not attend meetings at DSS with us. Kept pushing me to sign papers for DSS that he did not even review. They would call him in front of me telling me I wouldn’t sign assessment of 1. Safety requirements (which had me admitting to changes I needed to make) when I signed and wrote closely beside my name I do not agree with this it was tore up n I was told I would have to do it again not doing that. 2. Giving up my medical rights to my autistic son ( I straight refused) I still have all of Mr Brandon’s texts and emails and his refusal to represent me as he was only representing Beaufort county dss

public_comments.comment_text: This was my mother’s court appointed attorney she started with. I reach out to him asking him to get me in front of the judge and telling him what they put in the motion with my statements was a lie. I told him of the forced written statement was had to do with Abby Williams in a locked room. He did not submit anything or get me in front of a judge. He would t even prepare a motion for my mother making it known what I had told him so he could fight back for her and for us.

public_comments.comment_text: He has steadily ignored me, refused to file what I've asked, but my biggest issue is he allowed my 15 year old daughter to be interrogated by the dss attorney for the better part of an hour causing her to be quite ill for several days following.
